terms.comment: Greek ψαλμός, a song to the strings (psallere, to play the cithara). The book is the psaltērium, the Psalter (Hier. Ep. 53.8, Lewis & Short). The Orthodox and the Latin psalter number the psalms as the Septuagint does, mostly one behind the Hebrew numbering of English Bibles: the Shepherd psalm is 22 in the Vulgate and 23 in the Hebrew.

phrases.latin: psalmīs et hymnīs cum ōrātis Deum, hoc versētur in corde quod prōfertur in vōce
phrases.english: when you pray to God in psalms and hymns, let the heart turn over what the voice brings out

phrases.latin: et ipse David dīcit in librō Psalmōrum
phrases.english: and David himself says in the book of Psalms
